contract: ③ (lines_pack §2): MonsterService fires Moment(rec, "Spot") when a monster picks a new target (a personal monster once, when it first goes for its owner) and Moment(rec, "Hit") when a hit leaves it alive. BarkService (Config.Barks) turns a Hit below LowAt (30%) into Low once a life, drops a moment blocked by PerMonster (12 s) or PerZone (6 s, all monsters of a zone) with no roll (a blocked Low tries again at the next hit), rolls Chance (Spot 50%, Hit 20%, Low 100%, Idle 15%; a roll equal to the chance stays quiet), picks the golden set first for a golden monster, else its kind's, else Config.QuestKind's, never the same line twice in a row, and writes model attributes Bark, then BarkAt (server time). Every IdleEvery (10) s a monster with no target within IdleNear (40) of a player (the monsters that player may hit) rolls Idle once. Lines never change a score. A23-74 (user 2026-10-07): every line is a sound word or one short word in the monster's own voice (at most 2 words and 12 letters, no two kinds share a line, e.g. Slime 'Blub?', King Slime 'BLOOP!', Ghost King 'OOOH!'); the kinds and moments are unchanged.
limitations: The bubble is game dev 1's (MonsterLabels: watch BarkAt, show Bark for Show s within MaxDistance). The real aiStep / personalStep are checked as source text (the AI needs the engine); DamageMonster runs as a cut chunk. The optional goose barks (Lines.Goose, GooseService) are not wired.
